shortDescription: Module to interact with the GNU stow symbolic link manager.

options.name: dest
options.description: The target path where the symlinks will be created.

options.name: force
options.description: Whether to delete conflicting files in destination directory.

options.name: package
options.description: Name(s) of folders containing the files to be symlinked.

options.name: src
options.description: The source path of the folders (packages) containing files to create symlinks for.

options.name: state
options.description: Indicates the desired action for the module to carry out.
